name: indie-ios
description: The full idea-to-launch skill set for an indie iOS app: ship-app (which skill runs at each phase), new-app (repo template), store-assets (header, search-result and new-device images), first-impression (first-session audit and launch-week plan before 1.0), user-journey (journeys derived from the business, checked in code and walked in the simulator), plus pinned third-party skills for jobs-to-be-done research, acceptance criteria, SwiftUI, TDD, App Store Connect (asc), App Review checks, ASO, launch marketing, 12-month marketing plans, and referral, social, community, creator, AI-search and free-tool marketing.
